string-array.item: 塵も積もれば山となる
案ずるより産むが易し

string-array.name: anki_pocket_proverbs_english
string-array.item: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
When in a hurry, take the longer route.
Even a stone grows warm after three years.
Even dust, when piled up, becomes a mountain.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with one step.
Doing it is easier than worrying about it.
Failure is the foundation of success.
Good fortune comes to the house that laughs.
